# Appendix

Below is the full results table aggregated from every combination of model used:

```{r}
library(DT)
datatable(
  results_agg,
  options = list(
    paging = FALSE,
    scrollY = "400px",
    scrollX = TRUE,       
    scrollCollapse = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    fixedHeader = TRUE 
  ),
  class = "nowrap stripe",
  escape = FALSE
) %>%
  formatRound(columns = which(sapply(results_agg, is.numeric)), digits = 4)
```
